notes.title: 🛠️ Devlog #1 - 07/28
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2][p][/p][p]Development on [i]Monolith’s Dreamers[/i] is moving along nicely, and we wanted to share a little behind-the-scenes update with you! 🌟[/p][p][/p][h2]🎬 [b]Cutscenes are coming together![/b][/h2][list][*][p]We’re continuing to integrate new [b]narrative sequences[/b], and while we're at it, we’re giving the older ones a well-deserved visual upgrade: improved effects, cleaner dialogue displays… all to better immerse you in the story.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]👁️‍🗨️ [b]A mysterious new enemy appears…[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We won’t say too much just yet, but get ready to encounter a [b]creature[/b] that’s as strange as it is unforgettable. [b]You’ve been warned[/b]...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🌑 [b]A brand-new level just completed![/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Darkness[/b] surrounds you, and every step becomes a puzzle. Expect a unique atmosphere, full of tension and discovery. [i](Here’s a little sneak peek 👇)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308565/e967e068476f6e3f72ea4f8cebcb45a6aae3868e.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support, feedback, and kindness since the demo 💜
We’ve got a lot more to show you in the coming weeks, so stay tuned…[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you soon in the ruins of Monolith’s Dreamers[/b] 🌀[/p][p][/p][p][i]— [b]The development team[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update & What’s Next!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]First of all, a [b]huge thank you[/b] for all the amazing feedback following the release of the [b]demo[/b]. Your messages, observations, and enthusiasm mean the world to us and help us [b]improve the experience day by day[/b]. 🙏[/p][p]Here’s what we’ve recently [b]fixed/improved[/b] in the demo:[/p][p][/p][h2]✅ [b]Recent Updates:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]🔧 [b]Fixed a bug[/b] that prevented the proper functioning of [b]post-processing effects[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🚀 [b]Optimized shader preloading[/b] to reduce loading times[/p][/*][*][p]🎬 [b]Improved visuals and transitions[/b] in the [b]introductory story level S-0[/b][/p][/*][*][p]👁️ [b]Fixed an issue[/b] where [b]highlighted objects[/b] weren’t displayed with the correct activation state in [b]Focus Mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🌍 Minor changes to the [b]English translation[/b][/p][/*][*][p]⚡ The [b]energy tooltip[/b] for the [b]slab requiring energy[/b] should now appear when the player is nearby[/p][/*][*][p]🪨 [b]Added environmental decorations[/b] to [b]story level S-2[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🔮 [b]June-july roadmap?[/b][/h2][p]To keep you in the loop on how development is progressing, here’s a quick look at our [b]roadmap[/b] for the coming weeks:[/p][list][*][p]🗺️ [b]Improved map interface[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🎥 [b]Graphical fix[/b] for the [b]intro cutscene[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🐞 Continued [b]bug fixing[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✂️ [b]Integration of Chapter 3 cutscenes[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🖼️ [b]Improved murals[/b] for the [b]intro sequence[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Thank you again[/b] for your support, feedback, and kindness.[/p][p]
We’re moving forward [b]step by step[/b], and we [b]can’t wait[/b] to show you even more very soon!
In the meantime, don’t hesitate to keep sharing your thoughts, they truly help us shape the game.[/p][p][b]See you soon in the ruins of Monolith’s Dreamers[/b] 🌀[/p][p][/p][p][i]— [b]The development team[/b][/i][/p]
